title: AWS Serverless MCP Server project names can escape the deployment status directory
summary: A manipulated project name can read JSON files outside the deployment status directory. With write access enabled it can also overwrite JSON files outside that directory.

severity.rationale: The attacker must influence agent tool input and the impact is limited to JSON file access. Writes additionally require write access to have been enabled.

exposure: Exposed agents accept attacker-influenced project names containing traversal sequences or absolute paths.

remediation.details: Upgrade to 0.2.1 or later and patch derivative code. AWS provides no workaround.
remediation.risk: Low. Test dependent workflows after updating.

verification: Confirm the installed version or revision and exercise the affected workflow with trusted inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
Narrowed write impact to overwriting JSON files and recorded the AWS advisory score and publisher.
